Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for claim purposes. Can you state
your full name for the record?
A: I'd rather just go by my first name for now, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was driving through the intersection in Baytown, Texas, heading east on the main road. The light had been green
for me.
Q: Okay. What happened next?
A: A vehicle coming from the cross street on my right didn't stop. It hit the passenger side of my car. I felt a hard jolt
and my car spun a little before it stopped.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before impact?
A: Not really. I only noticed it a split second before it hit me. I braked, but there wasn't time.
Q: Were you able to get out of your vehicle afterward?
A: Yes, but I was sore right away. My lower back was tight and it's gotten worse since then. I went to urgent care the
same day.
Q: Are you still experiencing pain?
A: Yes, it's mostly in the lower back and it gets stiff when I sit for long periods. I've been doing some stretches and
taking over-the-counter medication.
Q: Did you have any back problems before the collision?
A: No, nothing that required treatment. I'd had a bit of stiffness after long shifts, but nothing like this.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Just that I'm willing to provide my medical records and whatever else you need to process the claim.
Q: Thank you. We'll follow up in writing with next steps.
</page>

Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
